description: A file opened from the files widget is a row of the left sidebar's own files list, right under the browsers, and shows full size in the main section where a browser page shows. One row per file per session, the path on the file mark's tooltip and a dot while it has unsaved edits. The row behaves like every other opened item: click shows it, the kebab closes it, and holding Shift turns the kebab into a red x. Closing a file with unsaved edits asks first. A save is refused when the file changed on disk after it was opened (an agent wrote it), with keep editing, reload from disk and overwrite. A binary, a file over 2 MB or a file that is gone shows a plain can't show line, and a changed file's diff shows read only. The files widget also accepts a pasted absolute or ~/ file path, including outside the selected project and without a session. Markdown opens in rendered preview with an edit toggle.
examples: Open main.py from the files widget: a files row appears under the browsers and the file fills the main section, with the session's rails still around it.
An agent edits the file while you have it open: your save is refused, and you pick reload from disk or overwrite.
Close a file with unsaved edits by holding Shift and clicking the red x: it asks before throwing the edits away.
Click a changed file in the files widget's changed files tab: its diff opens read only in the main section.
An agent opens plan.md with color cyan and icon docs: the row in the files list wears a cyan docs icon and name.
Paste a path to /Users/you/notes.plan.markdown while no session is selected: its file row opens in rendered preview, then edit and save through the usual stale-save guard.
how_to: Open the files widget (the files key on the right widget bar, or a files component), then click a file, a changed file's open, or a changed file itself for its diff.
Press open path in the files widget, paste an absolute or ~/ path on this computer, then open file. Markdown starts in preview; choose edit to change it.
Edit and press save, or Cmd or Ctrl+S; a markdown file has a preview toggle.
Switch between open files from the files list in the left sidebar; unsaved edits stay with each row until you save or close it.
GET /api/v1/files/open lists the rows; POST opens one; DELETE /api/v1/files/open/{id} closes one; GET and PUT /api/v1/files/open/{id}/content read and save with the sha256 revision check.

An agent opens a file for you with the MCP tool files_open (target, path, root, kind, and optional color and icon); it adds or reuses the row and does not switch your screen unless it also sets front true.
To make a row easier to spot, an agent can give it a theme color and an icon when it opens it, or later with sidebar_row_look_set (row, color, icon); a row with neither looks as before.
media_exempt: a new main-area screen and sidebar list whose reproducible screenshots are captured with feature_capture before the next version bump
name: Files opened in the main area
summary: files open as rows of the left sidebar's files list and show full size in the main section, with a stale-save check.
where: The files list in the left sidebar, under the browsers, and the main section when a file row is selected.
